description:
Activate Firedrinker Satyr by paying {1}{R}, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Firedrinker Satyr triggers, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, which causes the game to end in a draw.
